newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Italian firm wins $150 mln Colombian road project.
newsitem.headline: Italian firm wins $150 mln Colombian road project.

text.p: Colombian transportation officials said Thursday that an Italian-Colombian consortium had won a $150 million highway contract to link the city of Medellin with the adjacent Cauca river valley.

A joint bid by the Italian engineering firm Impregilo SPA and Colombia's Topco SA was selected over bids by seven other Colombian and international companies, a National Institute of Roads (Invias) spokesman said.

The 23-mile (37 km) highway will take four years to build and include a 2.8 mile (4.6 km) tunnel, halving the driving time between Medellin and the northwest city of Santa Fe de Antioquia, transportation officials said. The project will be financed by the province of Antioquia, the city of Medellin and Invias, the spokesman said.
